findings.title: Repository-path-shaped links remain unresolved
evidence: Tier-0 resolved 383 repository-path-shaped references in 73 scanned files and found 151 that resolve to neither a root-relative nor document-relative tracked path.

findings.title: Q3 current result and gate condition lack the committed raw inputs required for recomputation
evidence: RESULTS_INDEX.md:36-55 states Q3 is UNVERIFIED/NOT CITABLE because hpc job outputs and P1/P2/ELAS/POL raw discriminator outputs are absent; Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md:1-95 nevertheless presents current numerical polaron/shallow-donor conclusions, and Q0_NEB_GATE.md:10 and :60-66 use P1/P2 and the polaron test as PASS evidence for condition 3.
The inputs needed to recompute those current claims are not committed at this snapshot, so neither the result nor its gate use can be independently reproduced.

reproduce: for p in hpc results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/P1.out results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/P2.out results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/ELAS.out results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/POL.out; do test -e "$p" && printf 'exists %s\n' "$p" || printf 'absent %s\n' "$p"; done

proposed_check: C-RAWPROV-001 — parse each RESULTS_INDEX current-conclusion row and its declared authority/gate dependencies; require every named raw calculation output, manifest, and derivation script to resolve in-tree, and fail a fixture that labels Q3 non-citable while Q0_NEB_GATE still marks P1/P2/POL evidence PASS.

findings.title: The F-006 Q3 demotion was not propagated to all current authority documents
evidence: AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md:87-94 records the F-006 correction as a demotion to UNVERIFIED/NOT CITABLE and removal from gate evidence; RESULTS_INDEX.md:36-55 carries that demotion.

The same retracted Q3 claim remains unmarked as current in Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md:1-10 and :80-95, EXPERIMENT_AUDIT.md:82-143 and :232-238, and Q0_NEB_GATE.md:10 and :60-66. The latter two continue to present it as passed condition-3 evidence.

reproduce: rg -n 'UNVERIFIED / NOT CITABLE|no thermally significant polaron|V_I⁰ is a shallow donor|P1/P2 show no competing|no competing localised spin state' RESULTS_INDEX.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md EXPERIMENT_AUDIT.md

proposed_check: C-SWEEP-003 — when RESULTS_INDEX marks a question UNVERIFIED/NOT CITABLE, scan all declared authority and gate documents for that question; require each live assertion to carry the same demotion or an explicit HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED marker, and fail a fixture with the present Q3 index/gate mismatch.

findings.title: Tier-0 did not execute the declared repository test entrypoint
evidence: Tier-0 reports SKIP because test_command_enabled is false; therefore its receipt makes no deterministic claim about the test entrypoint.
Independent audit ran python3 scripts/20_test_checks.py in an isolated clone of the fixed commit; it exited 0 and emitted 36 groups. That result does not change the Tier-0 SKIP status.

verified_closed_findings.verification_summary: AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md preserves and individually resolves the three historical empty commits to committed state-ID evidence or a verified no-op; clean-clone regression groups 27, 32, and 35 pass at the fixed commit.
Recomputed scripts/26_neb_harness.py as SHA-256 2de0057fc5c81614d7f5cae85c129f22d523a2a093d00271baf468dab339132d and 12243 bytes, matching both q0 and q1 staging manifests; Tier-0 C-HASH-001 passes.

The q1 staging record labels the absent source and BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT rather than asserting it is present; fixed-path records declare unavailable raw provenance; Tier-0 C-HASH-002 finds no manifest-declared locator absent.
RESULTS_INDEX.md, Q0_NEB_GATE.md, results/objective2/CURRENT_STATUS.md, and EXPERIMENT_AUDIT.md agree on gate ALL FIVE PASS and launch NOT performed; Tier-0 C-STATE-001 passes.
README.md and results/objective2/CURRENT_STATUS.md declare 36 groups, and python3 scripts/20_test_checks.py completed successfully in an isolated clone while emitting groups [1] through [36].

summary: BLOCK: Q3 raw provenance is still absent and the claimed demotion did not propagate to all authority and gate documents. Tier-0 link resolution also remains failed, and its declared test check was skipped despite an independently successful isolated run.

coverage.method: Traversed the canonical index and objective authorities first, then their cited raw/manifest/script artifacts, all files changed by the fixed commit, Tier-0 violations, and an isolated-clone test entrypoint; independently recomputed Objective 2 statistics from 108 raw rows.
not_examined: No execution of HPC, GPU, scheduler, or instrument work was possible or attempted.
Large binary/raw archives outside the cited Objective 1 and Objective 2 evidence chains were not fully numerically recomputed.
